title: Duplexer Module - n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Elena Vasquez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Duplexer Module filter targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter. The filter is designed on 36° YX LiTaO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 2707.6 MHz and bandwidth of 91.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Satellite L-Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Duplexer Module
- Frequency Band: n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR)
- Application: Satellite L-Band Filter
- Substrate: 36° YX LiTaO3
- Package: WLP (Wafer Level Package)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Newbury Park Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Duplexer Module design targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2707.6 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       91.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.4 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 10.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 23.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 43.0 dB
Q Factor:               13151
Temperature Coefficient:-6.0 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.7 x 1.9 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   8
Electrode Material:     Mo/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the Duplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 36° YX LiTaO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2707.6 MHz, BW 91.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.4 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (WLP (Wafer Level Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, 36° YX LiTaO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz ZNA67.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 8123 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.4 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 10.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 137 MHz offset >= 23.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 9 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 2.0 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 95%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-08-15
Devices Tested:         83
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.14 dB
Return Loss (meas):     12.5 dB
Rejection (meas):       26.4 dB
Isolation (meas):       48.4 dB
Q Factor (meas):        13151
Group Delay Variation:  7.5 ns
Power Handling:         +35 dBm
Die Yield:              91.1%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Duplexer Module design demonstrated acceptable performance for n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Rejection at near-band offset requires additional resonator tuning.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Batch-to-batch reproducibility confirmed over 3 wafer lots.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
